title: Regional simulation
subtitle: Explore another regional factor while keeping the application's estimated energy.
invalidPeriodMessage: The period “{{period}}” is not supported. Choose 24 hours, 7 days, or 30 days to simulate.
applicationUnavailable: The application in this URL is not available in the catalog. Choose another application.
regionUnavailable: The region in this URL is not available in the current catalog. Choose another region.
regionsEmpty: No regions are available for simulation right now.
disclaimer: Hypothetical scenario: it does not change history or official results and does not prove real savings or migration feasibility.
loadingExplanation: This request may take a moment. No values are assumed while it is in progress.
contextPreserved: The selected application, period, and region were preserved.
emptyExplanation: No environmental data is available for this application and period. Missing data does not mean zero consumption.
clearExplanation: The application, region, and current preview will be removed from this page. Historical results and official reports remain unchanged.
searchAll: Search by name, code, or location
searchPlaceholder: e.g. Billing API, billing-api, or br-sudeste
pendingResult: The parameters changed. This result is pending; simulate again to update it.
historicalFactorsPreserved: Factors used in saved results are preserved.
queryNotValidity: The query time does not represent the factor's official validity period.
currentFactorAppliedToHistory: The selected current factor is applied to energy from the historical period. This is not an official historical projection.
referenceFactorsUnavailable: The backend did not provide reference factor details.
separatePreview: A preview separate from official results.
partialExplanation: Some measures or factors are unavailable. Coverage shows which data was calculated.
name: Application
helpParameters: Choose an application, period and destination region. The simulation is requested only when you select Simulate.
helpOriginal: Shows observed energy, reference CO2e and data coverage for the period. Historical data remains preserved.
helpFactor: Shows the selected region carbon intensity and the factor provenance supplied by the backend.
helpScenario: Applies the selected region factor to observed energy and compares it with reference emissions. This is a scenario, not a forecast of energy use.
